strategy: Technology Leadership + AI/Cloud Transformation + Telecom/Enterprise + Strategic Customer + Strategy-to-Execution
principles: Prioritize gaps that recur across target roles and can materially improve screening evidence within 30-90 days.
Do not try to retrofit structural history such as years in a major consulting firm; use positioning and selective role targeting instead.
Do not infer causality from a single rejection; require multiple comparable outcomes before recalibrating role families.
Never invent metrics. Reconstruct only figures that can be defended in interview or supported by records.
Do not redirect the profile toward pure hands-on AI/ML engineering unless application outcomes show that this is strategically justified.

market_evidence: Telefónica Account Executive Grandes Clientes explicitly manages targets based on revenue, new sales and customer satisfaction.
Telefónica Account Specialist Data, IA y Servicios Gestionados expects ownership and closing of complex, high-value Data/AI opportunities in large accounts.
Microsoft Senior Digital Solution Area Specialist - Spanish Speaking expects pipeline ownership, multi-year services agreements and measurable customer outcomes.
priority_gaps.action_today: Create a one-page Nokia/Telefónica evidence sheet with only confirmed values or defensible ranges for account scope, contract/revenue scale, proposals/RFPs, team size, strategic customers and business/customer outcomes. Leave unknown fields blank rather than estimating.
priority_gaps.target_evidence: At least 8-12 defensible quantified achievements across Nokia/Telefónica, CANTV and current AI/cloud work, reusable in CV, LinkedIn and interviews.
roles_benefited: Microsoft Senior Digital Solution Area Specialist
priority_gaps.selection_probability_effect: Not numerically assigned yet; expected to strengthen screening and interview credibility, but current outcome data are insufficient for a defensible point estimate.

market_evidence: Accenture GCC Strategy & Transformation Senior Manager asks for 8-12 years in consulting.

Accenture Senior Manager Product Mid-Market explicitly requires prior business/technology consulting and demonstrated business development, while preferring Big Four or transformation-consulting experience.
priority_gaps.action_today: Do not spend training time trying to simulate historical consulting tenure. Reframe verified independent advisory/technology transformation work as consulting evidence, quantify business-development outcomes where defensible, and deprioritize roles where major-firm consulting tenure is an explicit knockout criterion.
priority_gaps.selection_probability_effect: Structural constraint; improved narrative can reduce ambiguity but cannot replace explicit years-of-consulting requirements.

outcome_calibration.note: Accenture Principal Agentic AI Transformation Lead - Hands On was rejected pre-interview. This remains a weak calibration signal for very hands-on Principal Agentic AI roles only and is insufficient to infer a general AI-market pattern.
